description: Send a sender-metadata-sealed message: unlike app.aozora.convo.send, the stored record carries NO senderDid field and is written under a neutral, non-attributing repo ("mailbox"), not the caller's own. The caller is still authenticated (a valid session is required) so this is not an open relay for spam/abuse; authentication and attribution are deliberately separated (same scope Signal's own Sealed Sender has toward its own servers — the PDS still learns the sender at request time, it just never persists it). ciphertext MUST be an already-established E2E session's envelope (yoro-ui.interop.signal) with the true senderDid (and convoId) embedded INSIDE the encrypted payload. Exactly one routing field must be present (both or neither is InvalidRequest). Intro route (toDid + convoId): used ONLY for the session-establishing message (the envelope carrying the X3DH header), because the recipient cannot compute the session mailbox until it has decrypted that message. The stored record keeps toDid and convoId in the clear, so for this one message the recipient and convo ARE visible to anyone scanning the store/AppView; it is block-checked and Web-Push-notified to toDid. Mailbox route (mailboxId): every later message in the session (ADR-2610081200 R1). mailboxId is an opaque per-session, per-direction id both parties derive from the X3DH shared secret (base64url(HMAC-SHA256(HKDF(SK, info="aozora/mailbox/v1"), "aozora/mailbox/v1|" + recipientDid)), 43 chars). The stored record carries only {mailboxId, ciphertext, rkey, createdAt} — no toDid, no convoId (dropped if sent), no senderDid — and its rkey is random, so storage/AppView observers see neither recipient nor sender nor convo, only that something was posted to an opaque mailbox at a given time. Still visible: the request-time authenticated caller (to the PDS), timing/size, and that the same mailbox id recurs. Because the server cannot know the recipient, mailbox-route messages are NOT block-checked (blocks apply at the intro) and NOT push-notified (the recipient polls listSealedMessages). 1:1 DMs only; group sealed sending is not supported.

convoId.description: Required with toDid (intro route). Ignored and not stored on the mailbox route — the client seals it inside the ciphertext.

toDid.description: Intro route only: the recipient's DID, stored in the clear. Use ONLY for the session-establishing message (or a legacy session without a mailbox key). Mutually exclusive with mailboxId.

mailboxId.description: Mailbox route: opaque base64url (unpadded) session mailbox id of the recipient's direction, derived by both session parties from the X3DH shared secret. No DID is stored for this route. Mutually exclusive with toDid.

ciphertext.description: aozora extension: JSON-stringified yoro-ui.interop.signal envelope, with senderDid embedded in the encrypted payload
